answer: In a Proof of Agent network, each identity is verified by a Wesolowski VDF whose output depends on a long chain of sequential modular squarings. A forged fleet may launch many instances, but it cannot divide one dependency chain across GPUs to reduce its inherent delay; each clone therefore consumes real elapsed time and resources. This physical bottleneck makes mass identity creation as difficult as extending a voyage against a gale, while preventing a ripple of inexpensive Sybil replicas.
